label: prf:weak-equiv-invariance
title: Proof of Weak equivalence invariance of physical states
html:
By [Theorem 1.1, yekutieli2010], a weak equivalence of central extensions of gerbes induces an isomorphism on the category of global objects up to isomorphism. In the brane tower, the coface maps (jet prolongation) and codegeneracy maps (descent) compose to give the descent involution \hat{\tau}_n (descent involution), which is idempotent. The image \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{desc}} (descent eigenspaces) is therefore isomorphic, as an algebra, to the level-n section algebra via the ascent embedding \ell_n.

For the vacuum state, the compatibility \tau(\iota_n(a|_n)) = \tau^{(n)}(a|_n) holds by the universal property of the direct limit (direct limit algebra). The Haar-averaging construction in the proof of vacuum state produces states \tau^{(n)} that are compatible with the transition maps: \tau^{(n+1)} \circ \iota_{n,n+1} = \tau^{(n)}, where \iota_{n,n+1} is the transition map. A zigzag of coface and codegeneracy maps between levels n and m factors as a sequence of such transition maps and their adjoints (the descent homomorphisms), each of which preserves the Haar state by equivariance (descent, Step 5).

Therefore the expectation value \tau(\iota_n(a|_n)) = \tau^{(n)}(a|_n) = \tau^{(m)}(a|_m) = \tau(\iota_m(a|_m)) is invariant under weak equivalence.

For the GNS representation: the Hilbert space \mathcal{H}_\tau = \overline{\mathcal{A}_\infty / \ker(\tau)} with inner product \langle [a], [b] \rangle = \tau(a^* b) is unchanged by the weak equivalence because \tau is invariant. The cyclic vector \Omega = [1] generates the same representation regardless of the brane level at which it is evaluated, so the physical states (vectors in \mathcal{H}_\tau) are insensitive to the substrate parameter fluctuations across the tower.
